routes.label: Evaluate the derivative at the point

question: \(f'(x)=2x\). What is the slope of the tangent line to the curve at \(x=-1\)?
solution:
The tangent slope equals the derivative at that point. At \(x=-1\),
\[
f'(-1)=2(-1)=-2.
\]
Thus the tangent line falls from left to right, with slope \(-2\).
